Given the home page (Image 1) When I select valid distinct cities and click 'Find Flights' Then I see a list of flights for that route (Image 2).
Given I have not selected both cities When I click 'Find Flights' Then I see a clear validation message and remain on the home page.
Given I select the same city for departure and destination When I click 'Find Flights' Then I see an error preventing the search.
Given a results list (Image 2) When I click 'Choose This Flight' Then I am taken to the purchase page (Image 3) with flight summary (airline, flight #, price, taxes, total).
Given the purchase page When I enter valid purchaser and card details Then the 'Purchase Flight' action succeeds.
Given invalid card month/year (BVA: month ∈ [1..12]) When I submit Then I see field-level errors and purchase is blocked.
Given required fields (Name, Credit Card Number) are empty When I submit Then I see required-field validation and no purchase occurs.
Given a selected flight price P When I proceed to purchase Then the total cost shown matches P (+ any displayed fees/taxes) with no mismatch.
Given a successful purchase When I reach confirmation (Image 4) Then I see Thank you header, unique Id, Status, Amount (currency), masked Card Number, Expiration, Auth Code, and Date.
Given a successful purchase When I view Amount Then it equals the final total from the purchase page.
